input.name: subset_frames
input.label: Timepoints subset
input.description: Indices of the timepoints to keep in each converted file. Blank = all timepoints.

input.name: subset_series

input.name: subset_slices

input.name: vox_size_z
input.label: Z voxel size (micrometer)
input.description: Distance between two Z slices, in micrometer. Used only if 'Override voxel sizes' is checked.

ch.epfl.biop.command.process.deconvolve..name: ch.epfl.biop.command.process.deconvolve.AveragePSFFromSpotsCommand
ch.epfl.biop.command.process.deconvolve..description: Averages sub-resolution beads into an experimental PSF, re-centring each bead with subpixel precision on the spot positions of a TrackMate XML file. CPU only.

input.name: background_percentile
input.label: Background Percentile
input.description: Percentile of each bead's crop taken as its background level, subtracted before the bead is normalised to its own peak. A bead is tiny compared to its box, so the median (50) is the right estimator; a lower percentile sits below the background by about that many sigmas of the noise and leaves a positive pedestal in the averaged PSF. Lower it only if the bead fills a large part of the box.

input.name: beads
input.label: Bead Image Source(s)
input.description: One or more 3D images containing sub-resolution beads (e.g. the channels of a multi-channel acquisition). Each is averaged separately, using the same spot list.

input.name: n_threads
input.label: Number of Threads
input.description: Number of parallel threads used to compute the average

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.description: Name of the averaged PSF output source

input.name: psf_size_x
input.label: PSF Size X
input.description: Output PSF width, in output voxels

input.name: psf_size_y
input.label: PSF Size Y
input.description: Output PSF height, in output voxels

input.name: psf_size_z
input.label: PSF Size Z
input.description: Output PSF depth, in output voxels

input.name: trackmate_file
input.label: TrackMate File
input.description: TrackMate XML file holding the detected bead positions (POSITION_X/Y/Z, in the physical units of the source). Spots of frame 0 are used.

input.name: visible_spots_only
input.label: Visible Spots Only
input.description: Use only the spots that pass the filters saved in the TrackMate file (VISIBILITY = 1). Uncheck to average every detected spot.

input.name: voxel_size_x
input.label: Output Voxel Size X (0 = same as input)
input.description: Voxel size of the averaged PSF along X, in the unit of the input source. Because the beads sit at random subpixel offsets, a value finer than the input is meaningful.

input.name: voxel_size_y
input.label: Output Voxel Size Y (0 = same as input)
input.description: Voxel size of the averaged PSF along Y, in the unit of the input source

input.name: voxel_size_z
input.label: Output Voxel Size Z (0 = same as input)
input.description: Voxel size of the averaged PSF along Z, in the unit of the input source

output.name: psf_out
output.description: The averaged PSF sources, one per input bead source (same order)
